# Glass UX Image

Image editing components for Glass UX. Hosts own saving, transport and persistence. Pixels are linear premultiplied RGBA. Read the installed version’s public API before writing code.

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md)
- [Choosing a level](docs/choosing-a-level.md)
- [Host control](docs/host-control.md)
- [Headless](docs/headless.md)
- [API index](docs/api/README.md)
